@sul_mining_type = 1

# ============================================
# GOODS-TO-SPECIALIZATION TYPE VARIABLE MAP
# ============================================
# Maps each raw material goods to its specialization type (1-5)
# Used for lookups instead of OR-chain triggers
# Called once on game start

sul_setup_goods_spec_map = {
	clear_global_variable_map = sul_goods_to_spec_type
	# Mining (type 1)
	add_to_global_variable_map = {
		name = sul_goods_to_spec_type
		key = goods:coal
		value = @sul_mining_type
	}
	add_to_global_variable_map = {
		name = sul_goods_to_spec_type
		key = goods:iron
		value = @sul_mining_type
	}

	}

		value = @sul_mining_type
	}
	add_to_global_variable_map = {

	}

# Initializes the global variable map sul_rgo_map: goods → building_type.
# Must run before any RGO building operations (replace_rgos_with_buildings, new town setup, etc.).
# Called once at game start from the on_action chain.
